visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair and a black ribbed top holds silver metal chopsticks in a restaurant. She has a gentle smile and soft eyes, looking directly at the camera. The background features a white menu board with Korean text and prices, along with typical restaurant furniture. (2) The same woman suddenly changes her expression to a cold, neutral stare, with her eyes becoming sharp and unblinking. She maintains the same posture but the emotional atmosphere shifts from warm to intimidating. (3) A different young woman with long black hair, also in a black top, holds a glass of light-colored beer. She has a stern, serious facial expression and gazes intensely at the lens without smiling. (4) The second woman's face breaks into a bright, wide smile, showing her teeth. Her eyes crinkle warmly, and the overall mood becomes friendly and approachable as she holds the glass closer to her face. (5) A third young woman with short brown hair and a white tank top holds two pairs of chopsticks. She has a very high-energy, cheerful expression, mouth open in an excited laugh. (6) The third woman dances slightly, shaking her chopsticks and head with a joyful, squinted-eye smile. The restaurant background remains consistent, showing a casual dining environment with bright indoor lighting.

By contrasting visual expressions (sweet vs. intimidating) with the 'cinnamon roll' narration, it aims to entertain and encourage viewers to relate their own friend groups to these stereotypes.
